question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or solve long-prompt friction through inline growth/resizing, paste handling, and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing composer mode with draft ownership, keyboard, focus, attachment, and send semantics rather than fixing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts through inline growth, resizing, compact pasted-text handling, and the existing shortcut preference without adding a modal mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if the Control UI composer should stay lean and modal composition should not live in core.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the prior issue review and recently landed the adjacent Control UI composer shortcut preference, making them the best observed owner for this product-scope call.
